LESSON: HEALING THE PARALYSED MAN

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus
Topic 3.5: Healing the Paralysed Man

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Healing the Paralysed Man. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is the healing of the paralysed man significant to Christians today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the healing of the paralysed man

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the healing of the paralysed man
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the healing of the paralysed man. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Healing the Paralysed Man using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Healing the Paralysed Man in the examples.
2. Explain Healing the Paralysed Man to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Healing the Paralysed Man.
4. Show that you can: describe the healing of the paralysed man

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing the Paralysed Man using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Healing the Paralysed Man important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In pairs, read and retell the miracle in Mark 2:1-5,
2. In groups, discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the paralysed man,
3. Learning to learn: the skill of learning independently is enhanced as learners appreciate the miracle of healing the paralytic.
4. Digital literacy: the skill of using and interacting with technology is enhanced as learners watch a video clip on the healing of the paralytic. 36 Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
5. Non-communicable diseases: learners become aware of the causes and effects of paralysis.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the healing of the paralysed man

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
